newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech IPB shares fall after charges.
newsitem.headline: Czech IPB shares fall after charges.

text.p: Shares in Czech IPB Bank a.s. fell sharply in active trading at the start of the continuous session on the Prague bourse after two senior officials at the bank were charged with fraud on Tuesday, dealers said.
"I definitely see some nervousness," said one local broker. "It raises questions about the management of the bank," he added.
IPB was down 15 crowns, 4.7 percent, to 305 at 1000 GMT.
On Tuesday, two senior, but so far unnamed, officials at IPB were charged with fraud. The central bank said that the nature of the charges posed no danger to IPB.

The main privatisation agency the National Property Fund, which holds 31.5 percent of IPB's shares, also said that the affair would not affect the forthcoming privatisation of the remainder of the state's holdings in IPB.
